READ A1 RECORD SET, TRANSITION WITNESS FACT, TRANSITION GUARD
CLASSIFY EXACT, PARTIAL, CONFLICT, OR ABSENT
IF ALL EXACT READ FOUR LATEST PROJECTIONS
IF ALL EXACT AND LATEST EXACT T17 RETURN EXISTING_IDEMPOTENT_SUCCESS WITH ZERO WRITES
IF ALL EXACT AND LATEST NOT EXACT T17 THROW POST_TRANSITION_PROJECTION_DIVERGENCE; NO REPAIR
IF PARTIAL THROW PARTIAL_TRANSITION_CORRUPTION
IF CONFLICT THROW IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT
FOR FIRST COMMIT LOCK AND VERIFY FOUR LATEST PROJECTIONS EQUAL EXPLICIT BASE T16 BINDINGS
READ AND VERIFY S4 AUTHORITY REF, HASH, FORMAL RUN, SCOPE, BASE BINDINGS, CORRECTED BINDINGS
READ AND VERIFY ALL CORRECTED T16 FACTS AND HASHES
VERIFY T17 A1 RECORD SET AGGREGATE IDENTITY REFERENCES CORRECTED T16
VERIFY T17 DETERMINISTIC MATH TRACE REFERENCES CORRECTED T16
INSERT T17 A1 CANONICAL FACTS
INSERT A1 RECORD SET IDEMPOTENCY GUARD
INSERT MINIMAL TRANSITION WITNESS FACT
INSERT TRANSITION IDEMPOTENCY GUARD
CAS UPDATE STATE LATEST BASE T16 TO T17
CAS UPDATE CHECKPOINT LATEST BASE T16 TO T17
CAS UPDATE FORECAST RESULT LATEST BASE T16 TO T17
CAS UPDATE SUCCESSFUL FORECAST LATEST BASE T16 TO T17
EXACT READBACK OF FACTS, BOTH GUARDS, WITNESS, AND FOUR T17 LATEST PROJECTIONS
COMMIT
